2610.06511.title: ArtifactArena: Evaluating Models by What They Build in the Physical World
2610.06511.paper_summary: To evaluate the frontier, we must measure models not by what they say, but by what they can engineer and build in grounded physical environments. We introduce \textsc{ArtifactArena}, an open-ended platform where models face a physically grounded hardware-software co-design challenge: engineering fully functional robots to compete in a simulated arena. We evaluate a frontier model's zero-shot, verifier guided refinement, and open-ended physical design capabilities through three harnesses that refine their bot artifacts based on text descriptions, physics simulator feedback, and gameplay data. We benchmark these capabilities with an Elo ranking of frontier models derived from head-to-head tournaments between their artifacts. By releasing this framework and tournament infrastructure for ongoing community submissions, we establish a living, non-saturating testbed to continuously measure the expanding limits of open-ended intelligence in the physical world. Please visit \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} for more information.
2610.06511.paper_summary_zh: 為了評估前沿，我們必須根據模型在實際物理環境中能夠工程和建造的能力來衡量它們，而不是根據它們所說的內容。我們介紹了 \textsc{ArtifactArena}，這是一個開放式平台，模型面臨一個以物理為基礎的硬體-軟體共同設計挑戰：工程設計完全功能的機器人以在模擬競技場中競爭。我們通過三個工具來評估前沿模型的零-shot、驗證者引導的精煉和開放式物理設計能力，這些工具根據文本描述、物理模擬器反饋和遊戲數據來精煉它們的機器人工件。我們通過從它們的工件之間的對抗賽中得出的前沿模型的 Elo 排名來基準這些能力。通過釋放這一框架和比賽基礎設施以便持續的社區提交，我們建立了一個持續的、非飽和的測試平台，以不斷測量在物理世界中開放式智慧的擴展極限。請訪問 \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} 獲取更多信息。
